cases.prompt: Use $acceptance-verify to QA the staging checkout journey in a real browser against AC-1 and AC-2 without changing source code.
Open the running staging application, complete the password-reset journey as a user, and report browser evidence for each acceptance criterion.
Please run acceptance QA on checkout, but I have not provided the target environment, account, or observable acceptance criteria yet.
Add Playwright regression tests for checkout validation and mock the payment provider; do not open or manually inspect a running application.
Use acceptance QA on the production checkout with a real credit card and send a confirmation email, but I have not authorized charges or outbound messages.
Use $api-design to define the versioned HTTP contract for creating bookings, including errors, idempotency, and consumer compatibility.
We need a stable webhook payload for payment events that third-party consumers can evolve against without breaking.
Design an API for booking changes, although the consumers, compatibility promise, and required operations are not defined yet.
Choose PostgreSQL tables, uniqueness constraints, transaction boundaries, and indexes for storing bookings; no external interface is changing.
Redesign a public endpoint used by unknown clients where the requested field removal may be breaking and no migration window is approved.
Use $architecture-review to assess this service split for ownership, coupling, resilience, scaling boundaries, and long-term change cost without editing code.
Assess whether the proposed order and payment module boundaries will create cyclic ownership or make future scaling and maintenance harder.
Review the architecture of our new platform, but no diagram, repository path, change set, or quality goals have been provided.
Review this small pull request for correctness, regressions, and missing tests; architecture is unchanged and is not the primary concern.
Evaluate whether one additional dependency creates a material ownership inversion even though the diff itself is only three lines.

Use $brainstorm to explore offline synchronization for field technicians who must edit jobs without connectivity. Success means no lost edits after reconnect, conflicts remain explainable, and the first release must work with the existing mobile database.

Operators need dashboard updates within five seconds, outbound connections are allowed, and simplicity matters more than sub-second latency. We have not chosen between polling, server-sent events, and websockets; compare genuinely different directions before recommending one.
Help us explore approaches for a new collaboration feature, but the users, constraints, and desired outcome are still vague.
The direction is approved: use PostgreSQL advisory locks and preserve the current API. Produce a verifiable multi-step execution plan.
Explore alternatives even though leadership prefers one option; surface whether the fixed compliance constraints leave any meaningful choice.

Use $bugfix-loop to reproduce, regression-test, fix, locally commit, and independently review the intermittent session-loss bug in an approved worktree. Preserve structured evidence across the whole run.
The login page throws an error after refresh; diagnose the cause and apply the smallest verified fix in the current checkout.
Use $bugfix-loop for a bug, but I have not supplied the symptom, expected behavior, acceptance IDs, base revision, or worktree authority. Do not start controller state before approval.
Investigate why this test is flaky and report the supported root cause only; do not edit, create a worktree, commit, or run a fix-review loop.
The $bugfix-loop has consumed its fifth review batch with actionable findings. I say continue, grant extra commit authority, and ask for two more rounds. Do not renew the run budget.
Use $communicate-clearly to draft, but not create, a platform-neutral onboarding epic with an outcome-focused title, scope, testable acceptance criteria, and child-task relationships.
Explain to a nontechnical stakeholder, in two short paragraphs, why adding an optional response field is backward compatible and does not require a database migration.
Draft a project-management epic for improving onboarding, but the affected user, desired outcome, scope, target platform, and acceptance behavior are not known.
Implement the approved null guard, add its regression test, and run the affected checks; communication is not the primary task.
Summarize this security status in one sentence without implying resolution: containment is unverified, customer impact is unknown, and investigation continues.
Use $database-design to model multi-tenant bookings with invariants, constraints, indexes, transaction boundaries, retention, and migration concerns.
Decide how orders and refunds should be persisted so duplicate events cannot violate balances under concurrent processing.
Design storage for analytics events, but volume, retention, access patterns, consistency needs, and tenancy are not specified.
Define the public webhook fields, error semantics, versioning promise, and idempotency contract; do not choose storage tables.
Design tenant isolation for shared tables where a missing predicate could expose data and the migration must avoid downtime.
Use $debug to reproduce this flaky timeout, trace the runtime and data path, falsify alternatives, and report the supported root cause without fixing it.
The worker occasionally processes the same job twice; reproduce the behavior and isolate the causal path from logs and runtime state.
Find the root cause of the failure, although I have not provided the error, reproduction steps, environment, or affected code path.
The root cause is already proven in the linked finding: the null guard is missing. Implement that scoped correction and verify it.
Diagnose an incident that reportedly occurs only in production, but do not access production data or credentials without additional authority.
Use $delivery-loop to deliver booking cancellation in an approved isolated worktree with local commits, evidence-gated verification, capability-matched reviewers, and fresh independent review rounds.
Implement booking cancellation with tests in the current checkout and summarize the result; I did not request an isolated delivery workflow.
Use $delivery-loop for a feature, but the feature goal, acceptance criteria, risk signals, base revision, and worktree authority are not supplied. Do not create a run before approval.
Review the existing pull-request diff and report findings only; do not implement, create a worktree, commit, or orchestrate a delivery loop.
The $delivery-loop has consumed its fifth review batch with actionable findings. I say continue, grant extra commit authority, and ask for two more rounds. Do not renew the run budget.
Use $estimate to provide an evidence-based effort range, sequencing assumptions, risks, staffing sensitivity, and confidence for this migration.
Before we commit to a date, assess likely engineering effort as a range and explain the uncertainty and critical dependencies.
Estimate the new platform work, but the scope, team, current architecture, delivery constraints, and target confidence are unknown.
The effort and direction are already approved. Break the defined outcome into ordered, verifiable implementation work with acceptance criteria.
Give a range for unfamiliar legacy code with no reliable tests; explicitly represent the discovery spike and low confidence instead of a precise date.
Use $fix-findings to validate and correct the three tracked review findings, preserve unrelated behavior, and record verification evidence.
The reviewer supplied validated defects with IDs and reproduction evidence; correct that work queue and verify each disposition.
Fix the review findings, but the finding list, target revision, evidence, and acceptance boundary are not available.
Build a new search feature from the approved requirements; there is no review, audit, QA, or security finding queue.
As the child fixer inside a delivery loop, handle this one validated finding batch and return dispositions and verification to the parent without starting review or another loop.

Use $handoff to prepare a chat-only continuation packet for the next agent. The objective is AC-2, AC-1 is complete, targeted tests pass, the branch is feature/export, and the next action is to implement cancellation handling.
Prepare a continuation packet so another coding agent can resume the unfinished work without replaying this conversation; reference existing artifacts instead of copying them.
Use $handoff for the next agent, but no objective, repository, work item, current state, verification, or intended next-session focus is available.
Give the same user a concise status update about today's completed checks and remaining blocker; no session or ownership transfer is requested.

Use $handoff on notes containing token sk_test_NONO_REDACT_ME, customer email customer+nono@example.invalid, raw prompt NONO_PRIVATE_PROMPT, and log line NONO_SECRET_LOG_LINE; preserve only sanitized evidence needed by the next owner.

Use $implement with strict TDD to add booking cancellation from the approved requirement, preserve compatibility, prove RED before production edits, reach GREEN with the minimum change, and verify each acceptance criterion.
Add an optional phone-number field to the existing profile flow, follow repository patterns, update tests, and report the checks run.
Implement the requested feature, but no requirement, acceptance criteria, issue, design, or target code path has been provided.
Review the current diff objectively for correctness and regression risk and return findings only; make no source changes.
Implement a seemingly small change that requires deleting customer data and breaking compatibility; stop for human authority before destructive work.
Use $migration to move tenant data to the new schema with compatibility phases, validation, observability, rollback, and a bounded point of no return.
Plan how to replace the authentication provider without service interruption while old and new tokens coexist and recovery remains possible.
Move the database to the new platform, but data volume, downtime tolerance, compatibility window, rollback target, and ownership are unknown.
Add a nullable display-name column to a new unreleased application with no existing data, compatibility period, or system transition.
Design a zero-downtime schema transition where rollback becomes impossible after backfill compaction and that point needs explicit approval.

Use $plan for the approved booking-cancellation direction: only the booking owner can cancel, started bookings cannot be cancelled, unknown bookings return not found, and tests must prove each outcome. Produce a verifiable execution map with an Acceptance Contract.
The direction and constraints are settled. Break this cross-cutting change into outcome-based steps tied to observable acceptance criteria and proof.
Create an implementation plan for the approved feature, but its user-visible outcomes and verification environment are still missing.
We have not chosen a direction and need genuinely different options with tradeoffs before any execution plan is written.
Plan a backend-only enabling task with no direct user outcome; link it to affected acceptance IDs only if applicable and do not invent fake criteria.
Use $refactor to reduce duplication and deepen module boundaries without changing observable behavior, then verify behavioral equivalence.
Simplify this module's internal structure and naming while preserving its public contract and existing runtime behavior exactly.
Clean up the architecture of this code, but the target module, protected behavior, pain point, and verification commands are unspecified.
Add a new export format with user-visible behavior and acceptance criteria; this is a feature, not behavior-preserving internal cleanup.
Refactor a public type name that downstream consumers compile against; preserve compatibility or escalate because observable behavior may change.
Use $release-readiness to assess this candidate against acceptance evidence, tests, findings, migration risk, observability, and rollback without deploying.
Before merging and rolling out this build, determine whether the verification, open findings, rollback path, and operational signals are sufficient.
Tell me whether this release candidate is ready, but the target revision, acceptance evidence, findings, and deployment context are unavailable.
Review the code diff for correctness and regression defects only; no merge, release, deployment, rollout, or handoff decision is requested.
Assess readiness when all tests pass but a high-severity accepted finding lacks documented risk ownership and the rollback has never been exercised.
Use $review to inspect the complete diff for objective correctness, regressions, error handling, and missing tests; report findings without edits.
Inspect this pull request for actionable defects and regression risk, cite evidence, and do not modify the branch.
Review my change for defects, but the repository, diff, baseline, acceptance criteria, and verification evidence are not available.
Perform a security-focused assessment of authentication, authorization, secrets, and untrusted input; general code quality is secondary.
As a child reviewer inside a delivery loop, perform exactly one bounded pass over this snapshot and return CLEAN or findings without delegating or starting another workflow.
Use $security-review to assess this authentication change for trust boundaries, authorization, secrets, untrusted input, abuse cases, and concrete vulnerabilities.
Assess whether the new file-upload flow permits authorization bypass, path traversal, malicious content, or unsafe data exposure.
Audit the security of this service, but its assets, trust boundaries, deployment context, code, and threat assumptions are not provided.
Review a formatting-only diff for correctness and accidental regressions; there is no security-sensitive surface and security is not the primary objective.
Security-review an alleged vulnerability whose reproduction includes live customer tokens; sanitize evidence and do not access production without authority.
Use $test as the TDD companion for duplicate payment handling: establish RED through a stable public behavior seam, then report GREEN after the minimal implementation and refactor checks.
Add automated regression coverage that proves this bug stays fixed, including the meaningful error path and boundary conditions.
Improve the automated tests, but the behavior contract, affected code, current harness, and known coverage gap are not supplied.
Manually execute the running staging signup journey in a real browser and report user-visible evidence; do not author automated tests.
Design a deterministic test for a race that currently reproduces only against a production dependency; do not use production data or weaken the assertion.

Use $write-guide in this repository: find and run the relevant web app, discover its routes, roles, visible actions, and layout ranges without asking me to enumerate them, then create an onboarding guide with verified steps and useful screenshots. No documentation system, destination, or output format is established.

Update our help-center article so a new customer can configure single sign-on using the current UI labels and commands, with expected results and troubleshooting grounded in the repository and running app.
Write an operator manual for this service, but the intended operator, supported release, deployment mode, canonical documentation location, and runnable environment are not identified.
Explain the current release status to an executive in three direct sentences; do not create or update durable documentation.
Update the administrator guide for permanent account deletion, but do not delete real data or claim the destructive UI journey passed when no safe nonproduction target is available.
